name: Name Calling
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power of the tongue, emphasizing that words can bring life or death, and those who misuse it will face consequences (Proverbs 18:21). Jesus warns that anger and insulting others with derogatory names like 'Raca' or 'fool' place one in danger of severe judgment, including hellfire (Matthew 5:22). Believers are called to set their minds on Christ, who reigns at God's right hand (Colossians 3:1; Psalms 110:1), and to put away all forms of harmful speech such as anger, malice, and filthy communication (Colossians 3:8). Engaging in quarrels through name calling leads to unrest, showing the futility of foolish disputes (Proverbs 29:9).
